correctness.rationale: For every 2x2 SPD Stieltjes matrix, the optimal Richardson matrix has the exact form T=[[delta,gamma],[gamma,-delta]] with gamma>=0 and T^2=q^2 I, q<1. Since I+T is entrywise nonnegative, paired power sums give nonnegative even iterates and adding alpha q^(2m)b gives nonnegative odd iterates. The 3x3 rational witness has exact spectrum {1,9,11}, alpha=1/6, spectral radius 5/6, x^(3)_1=-1/108, and A^{-1}b=(1/99,10/99,0)^T. The finite calculations replay from verify.py.

originality.rationale: The new statement is the exact minimal-dimension boundary for coordinatewise positivity of the spectrally optimal fixed Richardson iteration on SPD Stieltjes systems. Searches found Richardson convergence/acceleration results and Stieltjes-function preservation results, but no statement whose implications cover the universal 2D theorem plus the 3D counterexample.

value.rationale: The result cleanly separates spectral optimality from order preservation for a canonical stationary linear solver on the canonical symmetric inverse-positive matrix class. The exact 2D protection theorem and 3D minimal obstruction identify where transient unphysical negative components can first appear despite convergence, which is relevant when nonnegative discrete states matter.
